surat.headline: Surat cluster faces input cost and labor friction amid Diwali operational shifts.
what_changed: Yarn prices surged between 45% and 66%, driving early loom closures, reduced working days, and strict 15-day payment rules.
Labor agitations, strikes, and leave disputes intensified, triggering reverse migration and worker protests.
Diamond sector shortened its Diwali vacation for the first time in four years due to improved demand.
stress_signals: Gujarat textile industry faces Diwali shutdown threat from a 45% to 66% yarn price surge [1b54f570ed7b, b62552cc0c7d].
Surat weavers shifting to a two-day weekly holiday under strict 15-day yarn payment rules [0c72a246c955].
Labor strikes, worker protests ('Gaon Chalo'), and legal disputes causing early Diwali exodus and job-work disruptions [d6a4b0e6a74b, 6b7974c7f88e, 73dfcce5d3f4].
Multiple cheating, fraud, and payment default cases reported involving yarn, fabric, and diamond traders [2514ad7d6e20, c4997bb35d98, 2718cba9f837].
improvement_signals: Surat diamond industry shortened traditional Diwali vacation due to positive demand revival [2b47ff4fa01a].
Diamond sector sees potential for wage cut rollbacks alongside technological deployments like BOTS.Ai at Bharat Diamond Bourse [7eaa09c3357d, ff0f473e0921].
MANTRA-trained entrepreneurs cumulative business value reached ₹120 crore [7dc3005e0b28].
what_to_watch: Monitor working capital drawdowns and repayment discipline among upstream weaving and loom units facing strict yarn credit terms.
Track labor availability and attendance post-Diwali exodus to assess restart capacity in embroidery and textile units.
Watch developments regarding the PM MITRA Park and potential new central textile schemes [64ca2830d472].
